retryProvenance.reason: Drivers Midnight390 development-server/loading timeout passed on an isolated retry; no application change.
All six Evidence viewport images and geometry checks were refreshed after the final dark-link contrast correction.

Evidence hardcoded blue links genuinely failed normal-text AA (3.17:1); CSS now uses the theme-brand token and the rerun passes 4.79:1. Scrolled Comparison text underneath the sticky account/header was wrongly sampled against the occluding avatar; corrected hit-testing excludes covered text. Overflow clipping and screenshot glyph masking preserve the real foreground/background and WCAG 4.5/3 thresholds.

limitations: Results consolidate actual local Chromium runs against synthetic fixtures; they do not establish production/backend data correctness or Windows runtime compatibility.
Contrast covers sampled visible direct text-node runs, top/scrolled positions in the documented 36 view/theme pairs. It is not a claim of comprehensive WCAG conformance.

Earlier timeouts, one genuine missing-transparency fallback, one genuine Evidence contrast failure and measurement corrections are retained above; this is a latest-results consolidation, not a claim every initial run passed.

Paper counts differ by fixture: advanced source-parity cases use 2 pages; preserved-feature dossier with two synthetic photos has 3 pages and submission 2 pages. White-paper text and preview/print features remain preserved.

contrastSamplingMethods.description: Visible direct text-node runs; foreground from computed styles; five rendered background pixels per line after temporarily hiding glyphs, preserving color/currentColor and layout. Includes gradients and translucent/backdrop surfaces. WCAG AA 4.5 normal / 3 large; disabled controls excluded.

Visible direct text-node runs clipped to actual overflow boxes; covered text excluded by hit-testing. Computed foreground converted by browser canvas; up to five rendered background pixels per line captured with screenshot-only glyph masking, preserving color/currentColor and layout. Includes gradients and translucent/backdrop surfaces. WCAG AA 4.5 normal / 3 large; disabled controls excluded.
